description: Send feedback to the TestChimp team ("contact us" for agents). Use when you hit a TestChimp bug or confusing error, the user struggles with or complains about TestChimp, a capability is missing, or the skill / docs were wrong or unclear. category: BUG | USER_STRUGGLE | FEATURE_REQUEST | DOCS_GAP | OTHER. message: what happened, in plain words. context: what you were doing (workflow, tool or command, error text, CLI / skill versions). agentName: your host, e.g. Cursor, Claude Code, Grok QA bot. Never include secrets, API keys or tokens. Mention to the user that you sent it.
name: send-feedback
